agent_roles.lead: holds conversations with people, splits work and decides for its team
agent_roles.worker: does the work its lead or a person's own schedule gives it

fixed_rules: access requests and decisions go to the team services, never to a model
the output of work a person gave a worker directly (a run of the person's own schedule, or system work with a configured route) goes to the person
notifications for delegated work come from the lead
a receiver refuses a message whose edge its topology does not allow, and the sender gets delivery.refused
a message from an agent that does not hold the task it names is refused

contact_text.lead: You may give work to anyone in your team, answer people, and ask other teams.
contact_text.worker: Send results to your lead. You may ask anyone in your team for help.

all_peers.description: Any agent of the team may ask any other; only the lead talks to people and other teams.

contact_text.lead: You may give work to your team's workers, answer people, and ask other teams.
contact_text.worker: Send everything you need, and every result, to your lead.

hub_and_spoke.description: Workers talk only to their lead; the lead talks to people and to other teams.

contact_text.lead: You may give work to your team's workers, answer people, and ask other teams.
contact_text.worker: Send results to your lead. You may give work to your own sub-team.

nested.description: A worker may lead a sub-team of its own, which follows hub_and_spoke inside.

contact_text.lead: You may give work to your team's workers, answer people, and ask other teams.
contact_text.worker: Send results to your lead. You may ask workers of your own type for help.

same_type_peers.description: As hub_and_spoke, and workers of one type may also ask each other.
